title: Harvest and Well
author: Orsen Delacroix
blurb: Edmund Oyelaran, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
